fields.description: Weekly issue featuring an editorial on the shooting death of Police Officer J. Franklin Beckham and allegations of jailhouse beatings and police mistreatment involving Charlie Haynes. Includes local civic commentary on Miami Beach’s proposed boardwalk in Lummus Park, criticism of Miami’s streetcar transportation conditions, discussion of bank withdrawals and financial instability, and a complaint about Florida Power & Light Company service practices. Contains letters to the editor, society/column items, and extensive local advertising for Miami and Miami Beach businesses.
